items.title: Sheaves of abelian groups on a site have functorial injective embeddings
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file injectives.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The theorem states that the category of abelian sheaves on a site has enough injectives and in fact a functorial injective embedding (statement lines 1058-1064). The proof is a complete construction: a family of sheaves meeting every subsheaf of every standard object is chosen (proof lines 1066-1072), the product of the family is taken as the candidate injective sheaf with the map into it built from the chosen maps (proof lines 1072-1082), and the injectivity criterion for sheaves shows that the candidate is injective while the construction is functorial (proof lines 1082-1087). The non-formal content is the choice of the family and the verification through the criterion. The claim is H2.
